C1.rationale: Level 3: Cross-stream team collaboration across mathematical and computational disciplines, oral and written reporting to diverse stakeholders.
evidenceLines: Graduates will be able to read critically and with understanding, to think logically, and to communicate clearly by written and oral means.
Graduates will be able to work successfully as part of a team.
The course will bring students in the three Data Science Majors together to share their knowledge, expertise and training in a way that is typical of industry.

C2.rationale: Level 3: Formulating and solving complex, multi-dimensional problems across qualitative, quantitative, and real-world business datasets.
evidenceLines: Graduates will apply mathematical and computational techniques and business sensibilities to real-world problems involving complex data sets.
Graduates will demonstrate knowledge and skills in formulating problems involving both qualitative and quantitative data.

C3.rationale: Level 3: Rigorous analytical reasoning in mathematical settings, critical data interpretation, and experimental hypothesis testing.
evidenceLines: Graduates will be able to analyse information critically in a mathematical setting.
Graduates will understand the role of speculation in the selection and solution of problems, the construction of hypotheses, and the design of experiments.

C4.rationale: Level 2: Designing data science experiments, exploratory hypothesis generation, and collaborative industry problem solutions.
evidenceLines: Graduates will understand the role of speculation in the selection and solution of problems, the construction of hypotheses, and the design of experiments.
Students will attend seminars by industry representatives from Data Science industries, and students will work on group projects related to real world industry problems.

C5.rationale: Level 2: Methodological inquiry using scientific investigation standards and integrative capstone synthesis.
evidenceLines: Graduates will have a working knowledge of scientific criteria and methods of investigation, and a concern for objectivity and precision.
This is the capstone course for the Data Science and Decisions program.

W1.rationale: Level 2: Authentic industry seminars, real-world data science project teamwork, and simulated industry practice.
evidenceLines: Students will attend seminars by industry representatives from Data Science industries, and students will work on group projects related to real world industry problems.
The course will expose students to Data Science as it is practiced in industry.

W2.rationale: Level 2: Highest professional ethical standards, scientific objectivity, and awareness of societal and economic impacts.
evidenceLines: Graduates will apply the highest ethical standards to their professional and personal lives.
Graduates will understand the significance of science, technology, economics and social factors in modern society, and of the contributions they can make in improving material conditions.

W3.rationale: Level 3: Advanced data processing toolkits, database architecture, machine learning, and econometrics.
evidenceLines: Graduates will be able to prepare, process, interpret and present data using appropriate qualitative and quantitative techniques.
